notes.title: Major graphics settings update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43804655/1867d69fa9eda789d73401bcd08ace50063b3a5d.png[/img][list]
[*] Fixed issue where graphics settings were not updating unless the game is closed. The graphics settings for the game now can be changed instantly via the options menu without quitting

[*] Added low-quality post-processing and reflections support

[*] Updated options menu

[*] Shader & Lighting fixes

[*] Audio and subtitles fixes

[*] Optimization & bug fixes
[/list]
